title: GenericHandoutExtraction
description: Fallback schema for documents that don't match appointment_letter or discharge_summary types. Also used for during-flow handouts captured at the visit.

probable_intended_type.description: If this document appears to be a billing statement, insurance form, or other non-clinical document, name it here so the UI can prompt the patient to re-upload.

summary.description: A brief plain-language summary of what this document contains. Maximum 2 sentences.

action_items.description: Any explicit instructions or things the patient must do, extracted verbatim or near-verbatim.

general_info.description: Informational content from the document (not actionable).

warning_signs.description: Any explicitly stated warning signs from this document.
